## Channel-aware YouTube analytics

Each publication is reloaded by the service-only youtube-analytics Edge Function, which uses its recorded youtube_account_id and existing Trellis account connection. It verifies the authenticated channel and the video's owner before retrieving reports. Google tokens stay on the backend; no shared n8n Google credential is used.

Legacy publications without an explicit channel return skipped/missing_youtube_account. Reconnect or scope errors return unavailable; neither creates fake zero metrics. Empty delayed reports also write no rows. Inspect Fetch Account Analytics results and coverage warnings for incomplete collection.

Deploy youtube-analytics first. Select the existing Hub Supabase service credential on Fetch Account Analytics and Upsert Metric Rows. Keep the applied migration 20261122005820_preserve_youtube_metric_ownership.sql. Import inactive, validate one mapped publication/day, restore normal Config limits, then publish. Never guess a channel for a legacy publication. See docs/youtube-metric-batching-hold.md.
